notes.title: March 15, 2017 - Cutscenes Update
notes.notes:
Different language cutscenes have been found!

The following languages are now available in cutscenes throughout the game:

    German
    Italian
    Spanish
    French


Please note that although you do select a language on launch of the game, you will need to switch to the appropriate language through Steam (This is due to the original installation process the game had). Simply right-click on the game -> select properties -> select the language tab -> select an available language.
